baseline_reproduction.comparison: Both painters are linked in one process with identical current Drawing/UiModel/support/SDL/core dependencies and current headers. Only the historical translation unit public names are renamed; the current production object is reused read-only.

fixture_state.manual_drawbars: All four banks: zero=0; eight=8; mixed-held=(index+manual+bank)%9.
fixture_state.other_state: Constructed SessionSnapshot and UiModel defaults from identified current sources; InstrumentViewInfo fields are fixed literals in the identified benchmark source. No physical device is opened.
fixture_state.same_object: Both painters receive the same const UiModel and InstrumentViewInfo objects. A field-wise layout fingerprint plus copied controls/held-state comparisons witness no mutation after measurement.
fixture_state.identity_boundary: FNV-1a64 layout/pixel fingerprints are reproducibility witnesses, not cryptographic source identities or exhaustive visual acceptance. SHA-256 pins the source, objects, archives and benchmark executables.

method.warmup: 30 draws per painter and case, alternating first painter on even/odd frame index.
method.timing: 300 measured draws per painter and case; baseline/current execution order alternates each paired frame. std::chrono::steady_clock surrounds real paint_instrument, SDL_RenderFlush and offscreen SDL_RenderPresent. Per-paint and flush/present statistics are also retained.
method.statistics: Median averages the middle two values. P95 uses nearest rank ceil(0.95*N). Raw total nanosecond observations retain original frame order; paired deltas compare same-index observations.
method.repetitions: One complete six-case timing batch; no reruns, outlier removal or best-of selection.
method.allocation: Separate optimized executable observes current-thread global C++ new/delete calls after 30 warmups, over 32 alternating paired draws. Twelve allocation/deallocation forms are positively calibrated before and after. Instrumented timings are not qualified.
method.gate: Investigate only when current median exceeds baseline by BOTH 15 percent and 2 ms. No case triggers. P95 deltas are retained without substituting paired-delta p95 for absolute painter p95.
method.quiet_window: Root, A26 and A28 postponed broad builds/tests/plotting until measurements completed; A23 raster work had ended. Parent was notified when window was released. This shared host was not exclusively reserved.

source_audit.new_rack_labels: sounding_caption returns one of constexpr string_view literals. EDIT BANK uses literals. The refined numeric readout uses one stack char exposed as a one-character string_view. Key highlights use local quads and primitive drawing.
source_audit.texture_lifecycle: InstrumentView adds no SDL_CreateTexture call or Drawing initialization. Drawing creates the existing two font and three optional art textures in initialize, before warmups, and destroys them with Drawing. The linked Drawing archive is identical for both painters.
source_audit.observed_cpp_heap: All 32 observed draws per painter have the reported maximum count: totals equal 32 times maximum. Wide Dimensional 21→19 allocations and frees per draw; compact 12→12; wide Flat 21→21. Thus no additional observed per-draw C++ heap calls for this refinement in these states.
source_audit.boundary: Observer does not interpose arbitrary C malloc/free, SDL internals using C allocation, system allocation, other threads, locks or callback timing. It proves neither zero heap activity nor whole-process leak freedom. Texture lifecycle review is source inspection, not a GPU resource trace.

resource_scope.rss_boundary: Linux resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss is the cumulative high-water maximum across children already reaped by the orchestrator. It is not a paired before/after heap delta.
resource_scope.storage: No images were written by this benchmark. Historical source, executables, objects and scratch logs stay outside the repository. This report retains exact commands/hashes and all 3600 total-duration observations.

limitations: Absolute offscreen software raster times on a pinned shared-host CPU are not hardware UI latency, display refresh, vsync performance or an interactive frame-rate promise.
No audio callback, MIDI hardware, window server, physical screen or real-time scheduling ran in this fixture.
This timing matrix qualifies scale 1 and the listed six fixed states only. A23 independently covers broader pixel/DPI/clip/interaction geometry; it does not extend these timing measurements.

Near-constant controls identify scheduling noise: compact/Flat hashes match exactly despite small positive/negative timing deltas. Their individual timing differences are not evidence of changed painting work.

Input SHA-256 values were unchanged at batch end. Shared build objects/archives were accepted read-only from parent; exact source-to-object compiler attestation beyond recorded source hashes and build handoff was not independently reconstructed.

The local median regression budget passed. Absolute wide paint remains about 112–114 ms on this software fixture and needs separate hardware-window performance work if an interactive frame-rate requirement is adopted.
